newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S.A.S. Dragon touches low on interim loss.
newsitem.headline: S.A.S. Dragon touches low on interim loss.

text.p: Shares of electronic components and fashion distributor and retailer S.A.S. Dragon Holdings Ltd fell to touch its year low of HK$0.59 per share on Monday after it reported an interim net loss.
"Investors were switching out from the stock following the disappointed interim and consolidation is expected after the selloff," said a sale manager at a local brokerage.

S.A.S. shares were at HK$0.61 at mid-morning, down HK$0.07 or 10.29 percent. The company reported an interim net loss of HK$15.98 million for the first half of 1996, against a HK$15.68 million profit a year ago. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
